question:
The line chart given below shows the sales of two companies J and K in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bfb3e2ed73646ad219ff6bcd53ddc6627aeb325e0f137a3f7f9ffe17792a6c1.png] 

P1 = The difference between the average sales of J in years D and E and the average sales of K in years G and H

P2 = The value of average sales of K in all years.

What is the value of (P2 - P1)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Average sales of J in years D and E = (400 + 600)/2 = 500

Average sales of K in years G and H = (400 + 300)/2 = 350

P1 = The difference between the average sales of J in years D and E and the average sales of K in years G and H

⇒ 500 - 350 = 150

P2 = The value of average sales of K in all years

⇒ (1200 + 900 + 1000 + 40
